annotations.title: Is this company dependent on one big customer?

description: Use when the user asks how much of a public company's revenue comes from one retailer or customer (for example Walmart), or is weighing the risk of selling through a dominant buyer. Returns the largest customer's share of revenue for each fiscal year tagged in the company's three latest 10-Ks, the customer's name as tagged, and each filing's citation. Refuses before you are charged if no share is tagged. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run.
